explication: The Claude SDK for Go is a client library for calling Anthropic’s API. An application configures a client, invokes a resource service with typed parameters, and receives decoded responses; the client also exposes beta APIs for managed-agent sessions and organization administration. The environment worker adds a session-processing workflow: fetch session details, prepare skills and tools, then run work. AWS and Google Cloud packages provide optional gateway authentication. The graph reflects README capabilities and available excerpts; unsampled resource wiring is shown only where supported by the documented API surface and tree.
